title: Viral Infestation
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 45 Poison Whisker Broodlings in level 1 of Widower's Nest

Quest Reward: 5750 Gold

Return to: Soldier Clohz

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 45 Poison Whisker Broodlings, 30 Poison Venomspitters, 25 Forest Blademasters, and Find and Destroy the Source of the Infection then Return to Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk on Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Offer:

No matter how much of a dent you put into the Poison Whiskers here on the Widower's Nest they just keep on coming. It is looking more and more like there is something we are missing.

Well, at least we won't fail due to a lack of trying to kill everything in sight! This time I want you to target the Poison Whisker Broodlings, the Poison Venomspitters, and Poison Whisker Blademasters. We are casting the net wide, but it may not be enough. I need you to also be on the lookout for anything suspicious that might be contributing to the dungeon's infection. If you find anything, destroy it. That's our motto: When In Doubt, Destroy!

When you have finished return to me, Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk, here on Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Turn-in:

Whatever you did, it looks like it has worked. Great job, here is your reward. Unfortunately, keeping the dungeon clean from infection is a full time job, so let me know when you want to give it another go.

Objectives:

  • Slain Poison Whisker Broodlings
  • Slain Poison Venomspitters
  • Slain Forest Blademaster
  • Find the Source of the Infection
  • Destroy the Source of the Infection

Client level range: 23–40
